name: rnaseq-de-enrichment
title: RNA-seq differential expression → pathway over-representation
description: Curated workflow: run DESeq2-style differential expression on a gene count matrix, extract the significant genes, then test them for pathway/gene-set over-representation. Chains two real, CI-gated tools; every value passed between steps is a genuine computed output.

params.counts: Gene count matrix {gene:[counts...]} or genes×samples array (required).
params.conditions: Two-group label per sample, aligned to columns (required).
params.alpha: FDR threshold for calling a gene significant (default 0.05).
